title: Chirp
text: 生成扫频余弦（chirp）信号；输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Frequency sweep} 指定频率扫描的类型；{Sweep mode}、{Initial frequency (Hz)}、{Target frequency (Hz)}、{Target time (s)} 指定 Target time of sweep、{Sweep time (s)}、{Initial phase (rad)} 指定 Initial phase of cosine output、{Sample time} 输出采样周期、{Samples per frame}、{Output data type} 输出数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 扫频余弦（chirp）信号 scalar | vector

params.name: Frequency sweep
params.values: 频率扫描的类型 Linear (default) | Swept cosine | Logarithmic | Quadratic

params.name: Initial phase (rad)
params.values: Initial phase of cosine output 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Sample time
params.values: 输出采样周期 1/8000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Double (default) | Single
